thread:
Maya: Quick sync — PR #482 needs a decision on terminology. In the SDK examples we say `pin model`, but the conceptual docs use `model pinning`. Which do we lock in? cc @Liam @Sophia
Liam: I noticed both. my vote is to keep imperative phrasing in examples (e.g., `pin model`) and noun form in concept pages. keeps grammar natural.
Sophia: I'm leaning toward a single canonical label for the glossary though, otherwise searches get messy. recommend `model pinning` as the glossary term with redirects.
Alex: +1 to Sophia. glossary should be the noun form `model pinning` (what the feature is). examples and SDK should show the verb: `pin model`/`unpin model`.
Maya: OK sounds reasonable. two part rule: glossary = noun, examples = imperative verb. we should also normalize variable/flag names in SDK snippets (e.g., "pin_model: true" vs "modelPin": true).
Liam: can we pick a canonical code-style key too? prefer snake_case for server-side config, camelCase for JS SDK. so docs should show both where relevant.
Sophia: Agree. Proposed docs text for glossary entry: "model pinning — locking a specific model version for a deployment or route to ensure predictable outputs." short, plain english.
Maya: Drafted line: "Model pinning — lock a model version to guarantee consistent inference behavior across releases." Thoughts?
Alex: Both fine. maybe include why: avoids regressions after model upgrades. add one example sentence.
docs-bot: PR #482 updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — added glossary draft and SDK snippet.
Maya: Can someone drop the before/after SDK snippet here so I can copy it to the migration guide?
Liam: Before (current messy example):
```js
// old
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'open-llama-v1',
  pin_model: true,
});
```
After (proposed):
```js
// recommended (JS SDK)
const resp = await client.generate({
  model: 'open-llama-v1',
  pinModel: true, // verb form in examples, camelCase for JS
});
```
Sophia: For server YAML/config example (snake_case):
```yaml
# server config
routes:
  - name: inference
    model: open-llama-v1
    pin_model: true
```
Maya: Nice. Action items: 1) Sophia to add glossary entry + one-sentence why. 2) Liam to run regex sweep to find occurrences and make a migration PR changing inline examples to match guidelines. 3) Alex to update the style guide snippet about code key casing.
Liam: I'll run a quick grep and push a branch. regex i'm using: `(?i)\b(pin model|model pinning|pin_model|pinModel)\b` — will export hits and we can review.
Sophia: I'll add the glossary entry and a short redirect note: "See: pin model (verb) in SDK examples."
Alex: I'll update the style guide page under docs/style/terminology.md with the two-rule pattern and casing guidance.
Maya: Timeline — can we have PRs by end of day Friday?
Liam: Yep, pushing branch today.
Sophia: I'll open the glossary PR tomorrow morning.
Alex: I'll open the style guide PR after that.
Maya: Awesome. One more: add a tiny automated lint check to docs CI to flag mixed terms (`pin_model` vs `pinModel` vs `model pinning`) until we finish migration. anyone volunteer?
Liam: I can sketch a simple grep-based CI job in release-war-room later.
Sophia: :thumbsup:
Alex: :+1:
Maya: Thanks all — I'll post an internal note once PRs are up and add to the migration checklist.
